closed_static_identity_contract.responsibility_identity_rule: RESPONSIBILITY_RULE stores canonical ResponsibilityRuleId; RESPONSIBILITY_EVIDENCE stores one exact typed-HIR-selected ResponsibilityEvidenceId; both are disjoint from callable ResponsibilityProfileId and runtime or backend relookup is forbidden
closed_static_identity_contract.trait_associated_static_selection_rule: TRAIT_ASSOCIATED_STATIC_SELECTION stores identity_id=SelectionId plus exact TraitId, RequirementId, ConformanceId, TraitWitnessId, ImplementationId, SubstitutionId, ResponsibilityId, item kind, direct-static-symbol metadata, and CallableImplementationId mapping; associated types emit zero runtime operations and no runtime reconstruction, search, fallback, provider ordering, specialization, or child-local replacement is admitted

responsibility_evidence_projection_contr.value_level_domains: owner_id_or_null, region_id_or_null, destination_isolation_domain_id_or_null and source_origin_id resolve in their typed-HIR/MIR local semantic domains and never become target identities
responsibility_evidence_projection_contr.callable_profile_separation: responsibility_rule_id and responsibility_evidence_id never reuse callable responsibility_id or ResponsibilityProfileId

type_header_cleanup_budget_contract.implicit_exact_root_rule: an absent non-resource root header computes the exact effective/exported envelope
type_header_cleanup_budget_contract.resource_root_rule: a sealed resource family root requires EXPLICIT_HEADER
type_header_cleanup_budget_contract.explicit_child_rule: an explicit child may equal or narrow the family-root envelope and must carry a family subset proof
type_header_cleanup_budget_contract.overlap_fusion_dependency: R33 is independently based on main; R32 scope/defer/loan-close content is not imported and any overlap requires a later explicit fusion decision.
